title_original: 주식회사 등의 외부감사에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 7 (Operation and Management of the Joint Fund for Compensation)
① The Korean Certified Public Accountants Association (hereinafter referred to as "the Association") establishes a Joint Fund Management Committee (hereinafter referred to as "the Committee") in order to deliberate and decide on matters related to the operation and management of the Joint Fund for Compensation as defined in Article 32(1) of the Act.
② The Korean Certified Public Accountants Association operates the Joint Fund using the following methods:
1. Purchase of government bonds, corporate bonds, or other securities designated by the Committee.
2. Deposit with financial institutions designated by the Committee.
3. Any other method specified by the Financial Services Commission.
③ When the Association generates revenue from the operation of the Joint Fund, the revenue (excluding expenses incurred during the operation of the Joint Fund) is deposited into the Joint Fund for the relevant fiscal year.
④ The composition, operation, and other matters related to the management of the Joint Fund are determined by the Association upon obtaining approval from the Financial Services Commission.
